artifact_reasoning: The primary artifacts are structural fusions at the connection points between charms and the chain (Router severity 2.0) and slight texture softness on the beads (Router severity 1.5). The spiral charm shows minor geometric warping. While the Perceptual Auditor found no noise/blur, the structural integrity of the small mechanical parts (jump rings/bails) is compromised, typical of AI generation. This prevents a perfect artifact score, but the overall coherence is high.
